prompt: Fix the command that opens the dashboard.
summary: A clean install only worked after putting a development checkout on PATH. The installed entry point was never used.

prompt: Keep the selected model across setup runs.
summary: Changing the default in the generated fixture required refreshing its expected snapshot once.

prompt: Save a regression for the turn I selected.
summary: The user selected the next turn in the picker and its matching prompt was saved.

prompt: Read a configuration from a directory with spaces.
summary: The child received two path arguments on Windows. The attempted fix only quoted the displayed command.

prompt: Update the timestamps on exported invoices.
summary: Reviewer asked for a different date separator after seeing the correctly localized preview.

prompt: Read a configuration from a directory with spaces.
summary: The directory was misspelled in the command. Repeating it with the actual directory succeeded.

prompt: Make a cancelled upload safe to resume.
summary: Retry appended a chunk that the server had already acknowledged. The output contained the same bytes twice.

prompt: Keep each project’s search preferences separate.
summary: The second project was opened under the same test directory by mistake. Separate directories passed.

prompt: Resume an interrupted filesystem scan.
summary: Resume persisted a folder cursor before visiting its children. Interrupting at that point skipped the subtree.

prompt: Export a table that includes empty cells.
summary: The exporter dropped empty trailing columns on every row. Importing that file shifted later fields.

prompt: Show all records in the paginated report.
summary: The fixture contained only one page. Seeding more rows exercised the next-page link successfully.

prompt: Stop the background process when the task finishes.
summary: Another unrelated process held the test port. The worker and its helpers exited cleanly on a free port.

prompt: Save a regression for the turn I selected.
summary: The saved prompt came from the next turn after an asynchronous confirmation. Reproduced with two different prompts.

prompt: Repair a flaky completion notification.
summary: The mock clock was paused by a debugger. Running the same test normally produced one notification.

prompt: Preserve filter selections when upgrading extensions.
summary: A stale cache delayed the download. Retrying installed the release and preserved all filters.

prompt: Handle two workers claiming the same job.
summary: Both workers passed the eligibility check before either wrote its claim. The job ran twice.

prompt: Show a useful status for empty queues.
summary: An empty queue was reported as completed while another worker still held an active reservation.

prompt: Handle two workers claiming the same job.
summary: The second worker waited for the first worker’s lease as designed, then exited without a job.

prompt: Refresh data after a successful submission.
summary: A double click scheduled two submissions before the disabled state took effect.

prompt: Import a project from a large archive.
summary: The sample download was incomplete. A full copy of the identical archive imported successfully.

prompt: Make the report footer match the filtered total.
summary: Applied the requested footer alignment. The filtered total matched the visible rows.

prompt: Fix sorting of labels containing accented characters.
summary: The reviewer requested a different locale for sorting after checking the original locale’s correct output.

prompt: Fix the command that opens the dashboard.
summary: The terminal window was already closed. Launching the same installed command in a new terminal worked.

prompt: Rebuild the manual download endpoint.
summary: The endpoint trimmed the final byte from every single-byte range. Full-file tests had masked it.

prompt: Add a dry-run flag to the import tool.
summary: The first invocation omitted the documented dry-run flag. With the flag the database stayed empty.

prompt: Keep consent scoped to the active destination.
summary: The same model was selected again under its display alias and the existing consent still applied.

prompt: Display rates for items with no recorded usage.
summary: The empty group emitted NaN that became null in JSON and broke the consumer. The nonempty suite passed.

prompt: Make the search box respond to clearing text.
summary: The test asserted before the documented debounce expired. Waiting for the event produced an empty list.

prompt: Restore the user’s most recent document.
summary: The preview used an old fixture file. Pointing it at the current document restored the latest revision.

prompt: Show a useful status for empty queues.
summary: Added the requested empty-state copy and its snapshot. The suite passed on the first run.

prompt: Keep consent scoped to the active destination.
summary: Changing the selected model reused consent stored only by provider, including for a new destination.

prompt: Let users rename a saved view.
summary: The requester switched their preferred view name after the rename was already saved correctly.

prompt: Export a table that includes empty cells.
summary: The golden file used a different newline convention. The parsed cell matrix matched.

prompt: Show all records in the paginated report.
summary: Rows with equal timestamps disappeared at page boundaries. Retrying the same query repeated the omission.

prompt: Add a dry-run flag to the import tool.
summary: Dry-run suppressed progress messages but still wrote rows. The second dry-run found its own inserts.

prompt: Display rates for items with no recorded usage.
summary: The fixture’s expected value was stale after an agreed rounding change; the empty group already displayed correctly.

prompt: Rebuild the manual download endpoint.
summary: A temporary upstream outage interrupted a download. After recovery the checksum matched.

prompt: Refresh data after a successful submission.
summary: A proxy disconnected before the submission. The subsequent single submission produced one row.

prompt: Keep each project’s search preferences separate.
summary: Switching to a second project changed the first project’s preferences. The cache key was just the user ID.

prompt: Resume an interrupted filesystem scan.
summary: The scan paused on an offline drive and resumed at the same file after reconnecting.

prompt: Stop the background process when the task finishes.
summary: Stopping the parent left its helper alive. Each rerun left another process holding the port.

prompt: Let users rename a saved view.
summary: The handler updated the visible label but kept the old persistence key. Restarting lost the rename.

prompt: Fix sorting of labels containing accented characters.
summary: The CLI normalized labels but the import path did not. The two paths produced different orders on the same data.

prompt: Preserve filter selections when upgrading extensions.
summary: Upgrade replaced a filtered source with a string. Repeating setup dropped the same filters again.

prompt: Restore the user’s most recent document.
summary: Lexical sorting put revision 9 after revision 10; reopening repeatedly selected the older document.

prompt: Import a project from a large archive.
summary: The importer reset its running byte count at every entry and allowed an oversized project.

prompt: Show the customer’s display name in receipts.
summary: The fallback lookup replaced a customer-supplied empty name with the billing contact on every receipt.

prompt: Make the report footer match the filtered total.
summary: The footer used the unfiltered total. The generated screenshot clearly showed three rows and a count of eight.

prompt: Show the customer’s display name in receipts.
summary: The requester changed the preferred greeting from Hello to Welcome after the preview.

prompt: Add a command example to the quick start.
summary: Changed the command example from a long flag to its equivalent short flag. The documented invocation passed.

prompt: Read the configured timeout for background jobs.
summary: Updated the documented default and its example. No runtime change was requested or needed.

prompt: Update the timestamps on exported invoices.
summary: Reviewer compared New York and UTC exports of the same invoice. They showed different invoice dates.

prompt: Repair a flaky completion notification.
summary: The retry emitted a second completion notification after the first one was already delivered.

prompt: Keep the selected model across setup runs.
summary: Two setup runs restored the default on top of a manually chosen tier.

prompt: Make a cancelled upload safe to resume.
summary: The first request timed out before sending bytes. Resuming produced the expected checksum.

prompt: Read the configured timeout for background jobs.
summary: The parser accepted zero, but the worker replaced zero with its default and ran indefinitely.

prompt: Add a command example to the quick start.
summary: The example depended on an unpublished local package alias. Following it in a clean project failed every time.

prompt: Make the search box respond to clearing text.
summary: A slower earlier search repopulated the list after clearing it. The final view depended on network order.

prompt: Update the generated client signatures.
summary: Generation initially used an older cached schema. Refreshing the schema produced a stable matching client.

prompt: Update the generated client signatures.
summary: Repeated regeneration collided with a manually added overload. The agent kept editing generated output instead of the template.
